name: Being A Light
overview: Scripture reveals that God's Word serves as a guiding light, illuminating the believer's path and providing instruction for life, as seen in Psalms 119:105 and Proverbs 6:23. Believers are called to embody this light, reflecting God's righteousness and serving as a visible witness to the world, fulfilling the purpose described in Isaiah 42:6 and Matthew 5:14. This light is not to be hidden but openly displayed through good works, so that others may recognize and glorify God, as emphasized in Matthew 5:16 and Luke 8:16.
